description_for_human: Context-aware PII sanitization for autonomous AI agent pipelines. 5 context modes (legal/financial/medical/code/general), Privacy Budget per agent, TrustBoost Score for M2M trust. Supports EN, ES (LATAM), PT (BR/PT), DE, JA, FR, IT, KO. No SDK required. MCP compatible.
description_for_model: ZERO FRICTION PREVIEW: POST https://api.trustboost.dev/sanitize/preview with {"text": "..."} — no wallet, no tx_hash, 3 free requests per IP. TRIAL: tx_hash=TRIAL for 50 free full sanitizations per wallet. NEW in v2.6.0: add context field (legal/financial/medical/code/general) for context-aware sanitization. Returns sanitized text, safety_score (0.0-1.0), risk_category (CRITICAL/PRIVATE/SENSITIVE/CLEAN), context_applied, and quota metrics. Privacy Budget: operators set daily limits once, agents operate autonomously. TrustBoost Score: GET /score/{wallet} for M2M trust verification. MCP Server: https://api.trustboost.dev/mcp — compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf. Proof of Sanitization: paid sanitizations are anchored on Solana. Verify at /verify/{anchor_tx}.
